summary: Retested backend APIs and fixed-flow UI coverage. Backend regression passed 10/10; valid borrow/return state transitions, all demo roles, cookies, logout, reports, shelves, CRUD, and five-failure lockout passed. QR, mobile sidebar, report tabs, and student mutation visibility passed in the UI.

critical.issue: backend/.env uses CORS_ORIGINS="*" while credentials are enabled; preflight reflects arbitrary Origin (including https://evil.example) with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials=true instead of an explicit allowlist.

minor.issue: Backend logs still emit PyJWT InsecureKeyLengthWarning because the configured JWT secret is only 26 bytes; enforce a minimum 32-byte secret, not only presence.

integration_issues.issue: Rows display API titles, but the second column is blank because Reports reads r.detail while /api/reports returns incoming.quantity and missing.code. Returned quantity/code should be rendered.

action_items: Replace wildcard credentialed CORS with an explicit frontend origin allowlist.
Use a JWT secret of at least 32 bytes and validate its length at startup.
Render report quantity/code fields instead of reading the nonexistent r.detail property.
critical_code_review_comments: Credentialed wildcard CORS permits arbitrary origins to make authenticated cross-origin requests; this is unsafe for cookie auth.
The report API/frontend schema is inconsistent, causing meaningful incoming quantity and missing book code data to be silently omitted.
seed_data_creation: No seed records created. A seeded available book was borrowed and returned to verify persistence, leaving two normal transaction history records; prior TEST_ records from iteration 1 remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested fixed flows pass, including QR state, mobile open/close, student hidden mutation controls, API-backed report titles, lockout, and borrow/return. Recheck explicit CORS/JWT configuration and report quantity/code rendering after fixes.
rca of the issue: CORS_ORIGINS is configured as wildcard and server.py splits it directly while allow_credentials=True, so Starlette reflects arbitrary origins. Reports uses a generic r.detail field although the backend response schema provides quantity for incoming rows and code for missing rows.
